stop_condition: Every claim the fix rests on is verified from the source of both sides rather than the comment asserting it; the new control is proven to TRAVERSE the cross-worktree arm; wtres_design_is_ready is shown fail-closed on every non-design error; no shipped test that pins the edited regions regresses; then no finding at or above high remains.

findings.evidence:
MEASURED, with a negative control.
WORKING TREE: `bash .claude/scripts/tests/approval-record-disclosure-claim.test.sh` -> 167 passed, 29 FAILED.
HEAD (1e86f47) control: `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C <scratch>` then the same test with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=<scratch> -> 196 passed, 0 failed.
Runtime error printed 9x: `<tmp>/ardw.sh: line 11: WTRES_DESIGN_DETAIL: unbound variable`.
Region hash: the extracted APPROVAL-RECORD-DETAIL-WORKTREE-APPEND region now sha256s to 043d61414b54f9207fdb6ce0b897cc1e66ecbb40a484fd12fd0e02a8cb6a5ee9; EXPECTED_ARDW_SHA256 at test line 1849 still holds HEAD's e0823a8ebda54e2c99fa52765238ed39f43ccb6f15dbef88d50bfec5360a511d (verified: HEAD's region hashes to exactly that).
Blast radius bounded by grep: APPROVAL-RECORD-DETAIL-WORKTREE-APPEND is extracted by exactly ONE test, and no other test names WTRES_DESIGN_DETAIL or WTRES_RELEASE_OK.
findings.description:
The new APPEND code reads $WTRES_DESIGN_DETAIL INSIDE the sentinel-delimited APPROVAL-RECORD-DETAIL-WORKTREE-APPEND region, but initialises it ~380 lines away at :6773, OUTSIDE that region. render_matrix_state (test line 2240) extracts that region and sources it ALONE inside a subshell with `set -u`, and reset_matrix_baseline seeds WTRES_REVIEW_DETAIL/WTRES_DELETED_TOKEN/WTRES_CHECKED/WTRES_WORKTREE but not the new variable — so the subshell dies before $LWR renders, and all seven matrix states (4.1-4.7) plus the four V1/V2 legs collapse. 27 of the 29 failures are that; the other 2 are the un-updated source pin (3.1b) and the M3 text assertion. This is worse than a red suite: 4.V1.4 and 4.V2.4 are the harness's own RESTORE CONTROLS and 4.V1.2/4.V2.2 its vulnerability legs, so an existing guard against false security claims reaching the operator block is now reporting 'nothing reached the render' for the trivial reason that nothing does. The shipped hook itself is fine (verify-before-stop.sh has `set -e` at :42 and no `set -u`, and the declaration at :6773 is unconditional top-level), so this is test-integrity, not gate behaviour -- but it is a `make test` break (the L1 runner discovers by glob) and it silently disarms a paired control.
FIX CONSTRAINT, please read before patching: do NOT 'fix' it by adding `WTRES_DESIGN_DETAIL=""` inside the APPEND region -- that region executes inline at runtime AFTER wtres_design_is_ready has set the detail, so an initialiser there would erase the message and break wtres-8b.4. Either seed it in the test's reset_matrix_baseline (the intended maintenance path, matching how WTRES_REVIEW_DETAIL is already seeded) or read it set-u-safely as ${WTRES_DESIGN_DETAIL:-} inside the region. Then re-pin EXPECTED_ARDW_SHA256 and whichever EXPECTED_M*_SHA256 values legitimately move, in THIS change set, as the pin's own failure text instructs.

findings.evidence:
The stated premise is TRUE: `grep -rn truncate_changed_files_tracker --include=*.sh --include=*.md .` -> defined qa-gate.sh:1295, called at qa-gate.sh:5436 only (inside cmd_approve, opened :3730, in the TRACKING-STATE FINALIZATION section whose own comment says it 'Runs AFTER every step that can roll back'), plus one component spec that pins that call site.
The conclusion does not follow: `grep -rn 'changed-files.txt' --include=*.sh .claude/scripts/ | grep rm` -> THREE more sites that empty the same tracker outright: verify-before-stop.sh:4698 (F1 doc-only cleanup), verify-before-stop.sh:7799 (release-path cleanup, 1100 lines BELOW this disposition in the same file), session-start.sh:438.
Also unstated: reviewable_changes() (:2187-2250) is tracker UNION (git status minus gate-baseline), so the transition needs BOTH halves empty; is_tracked_change (:241) applies only the denylist and never consults git, and post-edit.sh appends re-edits of already-baselined files unfiltered (:3937), so 'tracker non-empty, git delta empty' is the ORDINARY state after any prior approve refreshed the baseline.
findings.description: 'A concurrent, SUCCESSFUL `approve` is therefore the only known producer of the non-empty-then-empty transition' is presented as a conclusion from the single-call-site fact, and that inference is unsound -- emptying the tracker does not require calling that function. session-start.sh:438 IS closed, but by a mechanism the disposition never cites (94d.1's TRACKER-PRESERVE guard: an active `current-task` preserves the tracker, and A1b requires CURRENT_TASK non-empty, which get_current_task at :1941 reads from that same marker with no bd fallback) -- and 94d.1's own comment warns 'a future edit that loses the region defaults to DELETING, not preserving', so the disposition's reasoning would not survive that edit. The two in-file rm sites belong to a CONCURRENT Stop in the same checkout, reachable via the F1 doc-only fast path, an active override, or its own A1b arm -- none of which re-verified design, which is precisely the property the disposition rests on. No runtime behaviour is wrong and the gate is no weaker than before this change set; the defect is that the disposition IS the deliverable the task asked for, and it ships a completeness claim that a one-line grep in its own file refutes -- the same claim-wider-than-mechanism shape as the bug it fixes and as the HOOKS.md table it correctly repaired one layer up. Fix: name the other three producers and say why each is or is not a concern (the session-start guard by name), and state the two-halves precondition, rather than resting on the single call site.

findings.location: claude-workflow-plugin-3otl (Beads task record; no COMPLETION v1 comment)
findings.evidence:
`bd show claude-workflow-plugin-3otl --json --include-comments` returns exactly 2 comments: the prose narrative and 'QA-GATE: entered at 2026-09-08T09:09:08Z'. Counted by prefix: COMPLETION v1=0, IMPLEMENTER=0, REVIEW-ARTIFACT=0, RUBRIC=0, QA-GATE APPROVED=0.
Source-verified precondition: qa-gate.sh:2707 and :4720-4724 -- cmd_approve refuses (exit 2, error_key=completion_record_missing) unless the task carries a validated COMPLETION v1 record, with --no-completion '<reason>' as the only audited bypass.
findings.description: The specialist's F7 completion contract was never recorded, so approve's own documented precondition is unmet and none of the seven fields exists as machine-readable data: files_changed, tests_added, llm_observations and context_coverage have no recorded value at all. files_changed is specifically the INDEPENDENT witness the approve-time completeness cross-check reads to notice a change set that is SHORT rather than merely stale, so its absence removes the one signal that would catch that. The prose narrative is good and covers decisions/blockers in substance -- this is not a request for more prose, it is the record. Per qa.md section 10 the completion_record_missing refusal must be read as 'the specialist finished without recording its contract, in which case block and send it back' rather than satisfied by QA recording its own contract first or reached for via the --no-completion bypass, so it is routed as a finding rather than worked around.
